Text: funny how it comes full circle

Hermes helped me build the knowledge and ability to turn ideas that would’ve stayed in my head into something real

and now I’ve had the privilege of contributing to the very agent that empowered me in the first place

what an incredible time to be alive

huge respect to everyone else who has contributed to this incredible piece of software, and thank you @Teknium  and @NousResearch for making it possible ❤️
